releases.body:
## [0.14.1](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.14.0...v0.14.1) (2026-10-25)


### Bug Fixes

* **lock:** keep writers alive through mislabelled and vanished lock races ([21c21d7](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/21c21d755a5ad77691239c5b98c31d1191bf4e38))
* **logfmt:** retry the rename handover only while the destination is provably untouched ([ea03b91](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/ea03b91bdda4120490e8813f4b98040de49556d4))
* **logfmt:** unique temp file PER PUBLISH, not per process ([6359e28](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/6359e289384df87b4ef9d6ccd1cbc3020fd29744)), closes [#89](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/89)
* **resolver:** await DirHandle.close instead of chaining on its return value ([c21a9ce](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/c21a9ce5e7975f6cb247c2e6ac9c4a58853c1042))

# [0.14.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.13.2...v0.14.0) (2026-10-25)


### Features

* **capture:** mine the transcript AT compaction, before the summarizer eats it ([c531e27](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/c531e27e16dafd6b9bdbd6aa9cf096dd6ad3ad2b)), closes [#79](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/79)

## [0.13.2](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.13.1...v0.13.2) (2026-10-25)


### Performance Improvements

* **store:** batch supersession - one pass per file for decay and gates ([c476275](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/c476275b2b8de09215461b384063aefb6fc115b4))

## [0.13.1](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.13.0...v0.13.1) (2026-10-25)


### Bug Fixes

* **scope:** hash non-git repo keys so repo= is always a bare token ([24b2e5d](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/24b2e5d639de8072a7cc7004223349283486cd45))

# [0.13.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.12.0...v0.13.0) (2026-10-25)


### Bug Fixes

* **#45:** cluster ordering compares instants, not glyphs ([8610b45](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/8610b459fa17fd529acc6d40ab9779a6851e6c14)), closes [#45](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/45) [#97](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/97)


### Features

* **#45:** consolidation that has to earn its merge — deterministic, read-proven, proposal-only ([2751d3e](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/2751d3e4df4183f41e8d731d9255ceca843fa0ff)), closes [#45](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/45) [#40](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/40) [#45](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/issues/45)

issues.title: Non-git session dirs stamp repo as a quoted raw path — unmatchable by hash, fragile logfmt field
Session repo identity never binds on host 2.1.4 — recall silently partitions writes under the server cwd
P0: Lock read-modify-write paths (canonical registry, snapshot restore) — two-writer stress
persistent prompt injection: framing + provenance for injected memory blocks; stricter import policy
viewer: malformed Host header throws before the guard — Bun dev error page discloses stack/paths
